prompt:
In adults with chronic kidney disease, what do the active EMPA-KIDNEY trial and its post-trial follow-up establish about the durability of empagliflozin's kidney and cardiovascular effects?

Review design: systematic.

Include: Reports of EMPA-KIDNEY (NCT03594110) with clinical or kidney-function outcomes; Current CKD guidance used only for practice context.
Exclude: Commentaries without new EMPA-KIDNEY outcome data; Trials of different investigational medicines.

Starting sources (retrieve and preserve the current text of each; this list is not evidence):
- PMID 36331190 — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36331190/ — role: active randomized trial report — study: NCT03594110
- PMID 39453837 — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39453837/ — role: post-trial follow-up report — study: NCT03594110
- PMID 38061371 — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38061371/ — role: prespecified kidney-function analysis — study: NCT03594110
- KDIGO 2024 CKD Guideline — https://kdigo.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/KDIGO-2024-CKD-Guideline.pdf — role: guideline context
